name: Bloqra – Gutenberg Blocks & Page Builder for Block Editor
author: BeautifulPlugins

sections.description:
Bloqra is a lightweight collection of beautifully designed Gutenberg blocks for the WordPress block editor. Built with performance and simplicity in mind, each block is fully responsive, customizable, and works seamlessly with any modern WordPress theme.

✨ Available Blocks

  • Scroll Indicator — Display a scroll indicator on your website to show users to scroll through the page.
  • Accordion — Organize your content into clean, collapsible sections for a better user experience.

🚀 Why Bloqra?

  • Easy to Use — No coding required. Add and customize blocks directly in the WordPress block editor.
  • Lightweight & Fast — Only loads assets when the blocks are actually used on a page.
  • Fully Responsive — Every block looks great on all screen sizes and devices.
  • Highly Customizable — Easily adjust colors, styles, and settings to match your website’s design.
  • Developer Friendly — Comes with hooks and filters for advanced customizations.
  • Translation Ready — Fully translatable and multilingual ready.
  • Open Source — Licensed under GPLv2 or later. Free to use, modify, and distribute.
  • Compatibility: — Compatible with a wide range of WordPress themes and plugins. Tested extensively to ensure smooth integration.
  • Save Time and Effort — Bloqra saves you time and effort by providing pre-designed blocks that you can easily add to your website without needing to code.
  • Regular Updates — Consistent updates to ensure compatibility with the latest versions of WordPress.

Choosing Bloqra is a good decision you can make for your website. Download Bloqra today and start enhancing your website design and look.

Get Started Today:

Install Bloqra from the WordPress plugin repository and activate it on your website. Once activated, you can directly use the blocks in the WordPress block editor to create stunning layouts and designs. Customize the blocks to match your website’s style and start building your dream website today!

License

Bloqra is distributed under the terms of the GNU General Public License v2 (GPLv2). You may use, modify, and distribute this software under the terms of the GPLv2 license. See https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html for more details.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/bloqra directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Navigate to WordPress Posts or Pages add or edit screen and click on the ‘Add Block’ button in the block editor. You will find the Bloqra in the block library.
  4. Select the desired block and customize it using the block settings to fit your design needs.
  5. Cheers, Enjoy the plugin!
sections.faq:
How do I use Bloqra?

To use Bloqra, install the plugin from the WordPress plugin repository and activate it on your website. Once activated, you can directly use the blocks in the WordPress block editor to create stunning layouts and designs. Customize the blocks to match your website’s style and start building your dream website today!

Will this slow down my website?

No. Bloqra is built with performance in mind and only loads the necessary assets when the blocks are used on a page, ensuring that it won’t slow down your website.

Is it compatible with all themes?

Yes, it’s designed to work with all modern themes and follows WordPress coding standards.

Is Bloqra responsive?

Yes, Bloqra is fully responsive and works on all devices, ensuring a seamless user experience.

Is Bloqra secure and reliable?

Yes, Bloqra is secure and reliable, so you can use it with confidence.

Is Bloqra performance optimized?

Yes, Bloqra is efficiently coded to ensure fast loading times and optimal performance. There is no bloat or unnecessary features in the plugin.

Is Bloqra developer friendly?

Yes, Bloqra offers hooks and filters for advanced customizations. You can easily extend the functionality of the plugin as needed.

Is Bloqra regularly updated?

Yes, Bloqra is consistently updated to ensure compatibility with the latest versions of WordPress.

Is there support available for Bloqra?

Yes, there is comprehensive support and documentation available for Bloqra. The support team is responsive and ready to assist with any issues.

Is Bloqra compatible with other plugins and themes?

Yes, Bloqra is compatible with a wide range of WordPress themes and plugins. It has been extensively tested to ensure smooth integration.

Is Bloqra open source?

Yes, Bloqra is fully open-source with a GPLv2 or later license. You have the freedom to modify and distribute the plugin under the license terms.
